lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn3V2Ge crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Pmmm (No. 143), with a unit cell containing six atoms distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ge centers with 12 geometric neighbors (4 Ge, 6 Mn, 2 V), Mn centers with 10 neighbors (4 Ge, 4 Mn, 2 V), and V centers with 9 neighbors (5 Ge, 4 Mn). The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all six sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Ge, Mn, and V coordination polyhedra.
